visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair and a blue surgical mask stands behind a food stall counter at dusk. Neon signs shaped like beer mugs and colorful skewers glow brightly in the foreground. He is focused on organizing ingredients on a tray. (2) Extreme close-up of meat skewers being grilled on a rotating mechanical rack. The meat is browning and glossy with fat. (3) Inside a brightly lit restaurant, a man with his hair in a top knot and a woman with glasses hold microphones and sing enthusiastically. In front of them is a four-compartment hotpot and various side dishes on a wooden table. (4) Close-up shots of skewers being brushed with a thick, dark sauce on a metal tray, followed by skewers rotating in an automatic grill. (5) A hand holds a colorful paper cup packed with grilled skewers seasoned with sesame seeds. (6) A large, square four-compartment hotpot pot is lowered onto an induction cooker. The compartments contain different colored broths: vibrant red, creamy white, and tomato-based orange. (7) Close-up of a ladle lifting large tomato chunks from the orange broth, and another shot of wavy noodles being lifted, coated in thick sauce. (8) Successive shots of thinly sliced raw meat being dipped into boiling red broth and a bowl of white rice topped with a piece of cooked meat. (9) A large wooden platter of various grilled skewers is presented on the table next to the hotpot. (10) The man and woman are seen singing again, smiling and gesturing with their hands. (11) A person pours amber liquid into glasses, followed by a close-up of two Budweiser beer bottles being clinked together. (12) The camera pans across the restaurant interior, showing other diners at tables. The final shots show a large banner with red Chinese characters and a close-up of the restaurant's red and white logo.
